user.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open this link in your browser, but **don't log in yet**:

{login_url}

2. Open Developer Tools first: **F12**, or right-click → **Inspect**. Click the **Network** tab and turn on "Preserve log" (checkbox top-left of that tab).
3. Now log in with your AH account.
4. After logging in, the page tries to redirect to an address starting with `appie://login-exit?code=...`. Your browser can't open that — that's expected. A row for it appears in the Network tab, usually red or marked "(failed)", starting with `login-exit`.
5. Right-click that row → **Copy** → **Copy URL**.
6. Paste that URL (or just the part after `code=`) below.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Albert Heijn again
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Albert Heijn session has expired. Repeat the login steps:

1. Open this link in your browser, but **don't log in yet**:

{login_url}

2. Open Developer Tools first: **F12**, or right-click → **Inspect**. Click the **Network** tab and turn on "Preserve log" (checkbox top-left of that tab).
3. Now log in with your AH account.
4. After logging in, the page tries to redirect to an address starting with `appie://login-exit?code=...`. Your browser can't open that — that's expected. A row for it appears in the Network tab, usually red or marked "(failed)", starting with `login-exit`.
5. Right-click that row → **Copy** → **Copy URL**.
6. Paste that URL (or just the part after `code=`) below.

error.invalid_code: Could not find a login code in what you pasted. Paste the full `appie://login-exit?code=...` URL or just the code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not exchange the login code for an Albert Heijn session. The code may have expired — redo the login steps and paste a fresh code.

abort.reauth_successful: Logged in again; the shopping list works again.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different AH account than before. Log in with the original account, or remove and re-add the integration.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to the Albert Heijn shopping list, as free text or linked to an AH product.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to add, e.g. "pindakaas". Leave empty when using a product ID.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Exact AH webshopId (from a product URL or search_products). Takes precedence over name.

link_product.name: Link to product
link_product.description: Search the AH assortment for the name and link a confident match; otherwise free text.

search_products.name: Search products
search_products.description: Searches the AH assortment and returns products with their product ID, price and bonus.

checkout.name: Send to basket
checkout.description: Adds unchecked, product-linked items to your active AH order. Quantities already in the basket are kept and added to. Free-text items are skipped.

clear_list.name: Clear shopping list
clear_list.description: Removes all items from the Albert Heijn shopping list.

init.title: Settings
init.description: The list is always fetched when you open it in Home Assistant, every minute while it stays open, and right after changes made from Home Assistant. The background refresh is what automations and voice assistants see when nobody has the list open (0 = off).

data.link_products: Link typed items to AH products (search; falls back to free text)

auth_expired.message: Your Albert Heijn login has expired. Log in again via the notification under Settings.

api_error.message: Albert Heijn did not respond as expected: {error}

item_not_found.message: That item is no longer on the Albert Heijn list. Refresh and try again.

name_or_product_required.message: Give a name or a product ID.
